question: What is the meaning of production site code type in accordance with any internationally recognized system in relation to production site information?
data_point: production site code type in accordance with any internationally recognized system
description: The meaning of production site code type in accordance with any internationally recognized system in relation to production site information is that the code used to identify the production site should adhere to a globally accepted standard for identification, such as ISO/IEC 6523-1 or any other relevant international site identification system.
